About Us

Collins Interior & Allied Service Limited

Excellence in Interiors & Security Solutions

Collins Interior & Allied Service Limited is a registered Nigerian company (RC: 1128519) specializing in premium interior solutions. Under the leadership of our Director, Collins E. Madueke, we supply and install banker's and treasury safes, security equipment, and exclusive furniture for offices and homes.

From our showroom at Shop 9, Rachas Plaza, Wuse Zone 3, Abuja, we serve corporate clients, financial institutions, and discerning homeowners across the Federal Capital Territory and nationwide.
